subsystem: jev-only synthesizer (Ledger + Sieve: src/synth/index.ts, src/synth/search/*, src/synth/sieve/*, src/synth/rank, src/synth/oracle) read as a reusable engine for LLM+Jev
summary: The engine is a strict layering: code enumerates Candidates at localised Sites, code decides SIEVE-vs-RANK by measured run cost (budget.ts:795), the sieve verifies every queued candidate on shadow lanes and classifies it arithmetically (runner.ts:349), the guard commits a lone passer and asks Jev only when tests cannot separate several passers (guard.ts:738), and the controller emits exactly one Proposal per synthesize() with the shadow run attached as ProposalEvidence (search/index.ts:511, proposal.ts:261). Every seam an LLM source needs already exists: the Candidate record (site + text + op + extraEdits[] with paths + provenance; types.ts:62-82) supports multi-line text, statement spans (Site.endLine) and up to 2 files; the async `JevSource` interface (subgoal.ts:245-247) with `JevSourceInput {ctx, mem, goal, site, opts, prior}` is the natural plug (SKETCH and BEAM already use it at subgoal.ts:752-759); the queue, runner, guard, bases and proposal builders are source-agnostic. Minimum changes: a new CandidateSourceName wired into four exhaustive records, a new Phase or a `llm?: JevSource` slot in SubGoalDeps with its gate in searchSubGoal, a budget counter for LLM spend (StepBudget only counts Jev requests), a sanctioned generating-model channel on SynthesisContext (jev-only throws on any generator call, engine.ts:1698), and either extraNames or a vocab bypass so LLM-introduced identifiers survive the pre-check. Single-line assumptions are concentrated in the identity/display layer (siteKey, isUnchanged, editCost, candidateJson, patchGoalText, PersistedPartial) rather than in apply/verify, and composite.ts explicitly excludes multi-line text.

decision_points.what: The central decision: SIEVE (run the whole candidate set, tests rank) when |cands| ≤ runsLeft AND t_run(goalSubset) ≤ SIEVE_MAX_T_RUN_MS 2000; else RANK with K = 3 (replace) / 5 (insert) / ≥5 when N ≥ 61 (compact Nouls) / up to RANK_K_SITE_MAX 16 as the site's share of runs on a cheap-repro repository oracle. runsLeft = min(testRunsLeft, floor(testWallLeft × lanes / t_run)). decision_points.what: The inner loop: for each PHASE (SEEDS, SKETCH, BEAM, WIDENED) × bases (committed first) × sites (localiser order, insert-first under Q7) × sources (orderSources minus goal.exhausted[siteKey#phase]). In SEEDS/WIDENED on a SIEVE oracle the three seed sources are enumerated together and queued as ONE batch decided ONCE (visitSeedBatch); composite unlocks once seeds are exhausted at the site. SKETCH only at top-3 sites with seeds exhausted; BEAM only at top-2 sites where SKETCH ran and ≥ 35 Jev requests remain; WIDENED only on ≤ 2 non-test .py files (or under change_approach) after every site's seeds are exhausted, cursor-carried in mem.widenCursor, ≤ WIDENED_SITES_MAX 24 sites in chunks of 6. A source is exhausted at a site only when everything queued ran to a verdict (:802-803, :862-865). Exits: commit / budget (exitOnBudget :925-936 runs pairs, commits held passer, then progress commit) / parked (describeExhaustion :434-441).

reusable_for_llm_jev: Candidate contract (src/synth/types.ts:62-75): {id, site: Site, text, source: CandidateSourceName, op, extraEdits?: LineEdit[], prior?, provenance?}. `text` may be multi-line (verify/apply.ts:27-30 indentedText keeps relative indentation; py/edits.ts:78-87 replaceLine splits on '\n'); extraEdits are {path, line, kind: replace|insert|delete, text?} in BEFORE-edit line numbers, applied bottom-up per file (apply.ts:139-146), any path present in the base's `files` map (apply.ts:94-99). An LLM hunk set = one Site edit + N extraEdits.

Multi-file support exists but is capped: MAX_PATCH_FILES 2 (search/proposal.ts:40) enforced at proposePatch (:648-649), pairsOfPartials (bases.ts:468) and commitProgress (subgoal.ts:672-677); the composite signature + call-site unit (search/composite.ts:9-11, :311-566) is the existing two-file example; per-file vocabulary check (sieve/queue.ts:216-223); the Q15 state shows other files (guard.ts:486-490) and `also_edits`/`file` per candidate (:452-458).

Statement-level spans exist: Site.endLine (types.ts:36) built by localize/sites.ts:316-336 statementSiteAt (joined tokens as currentLine), applied by deleting continuation lines (apply.ts:78-84, :116-122); an extra edit inside the span is refused (:102-104); siteOnBase compares the span on an improved base (subgoal.ts:375-379). Composite refuses extraEdits at span sites (composite.ts:279).

Async source plug: `JevSource { enumerate(input: JevSourceInput): Promise<JevEnumeration> }` (subgoal.ts:228-247) with input {ctx (ask, sandbox, task, signal, emit), mem (stepBudget, oracle, bases, localizeCache), goal (tests, failures: FailureView[testId, call, expected, actual]), site, opts: EnumerateOptions, prior}; output {candidates, requests, editClass?}. Consumed at subgoal.ts:752-759 for SKETCH/BEAM: requests are charged via spend() to jevRequestsLeft, candidates pass freshOf (unchanged + tried filter) then decideRunPlan → SIEVE or RANK like any set. This is the seam for an LLM source; the sync `CandidateSource.enumerate` (types.ts:120-124, documented 'deterministic, pure') is not.

Alternative sync pattern: beam/source.ts:67-140 — an async `synthesizeLine` caches per siteKey (path + sha12(file.src) + line + kind + currentLine, :59-61) and the sync `enumerate` surfaces the cache with a relative prior. An LLM source could pre-fetch in a pre-phase and surface through this shape to fit `SubGoalDeps.seeds`.

Dependency injection points: SubGoalDeps (subgoal.ts:263-280: seeds {mutation, template, donor, composite} fixed record, sketch, beam, rank, createQueue, runQueue, decide, pairsOfPartials, regressionRun?) built by createSubGoalDeps (src/synth/index.ts:217-263) and SearchDeps (search/index.ts:112-144) built by searchDeps (index.ts:265-268); unit fakes in test/unit/synth/search/controller-fakes.ts and subgoal.test.ts:154-160 show how a fake sketch/beam JevSource is injected.

Phase machinery: PHASES/Phase (search/types.ts:10-11), orderSources (subgoal.ts:182-201) returns ['token_beam'] for SKETCH and BEAM, exhaustedKey adds '#SKETCH' (:292-294) so two phases sharing a source name do not collide; phase gates in searchSubGoal (:994-1005). A new 'LLM' phase = one PHASES entry, one orderSources case, one exhaustedKey suffix, one switch case with its entry rule, and the `phase === 'SKETCH' || phase === 'BEAM'` test at :752 extended.

Verification queue reusable as is: VerifyQueue (sieve/queue.ts:355-495) with jobFor (:295-299) and key (base.passed, p, sourcePrior); dedupe by id per base and by canonical token text (:458-459); SOURCE_ORDER_PRIOR default priors (:58-66); carryOver (:439-443) for RANK-mode p that cost a request.

What Jev is measured to be good at inside this engine (the split to keep in LLM+Jev): arbitration among test-passing candidates (Q15/Q16: 10/10 and 13/14 gold-or-equivalent, design §2.6), ranking ≤ 10 options (36/40) and shortlisting from hundreds (fix in Noul top-5 39/40), fix-absent detection (AUROC 0.916, rank/index.ts:67), line localisation top-3 (36/40), attack-first ordering; measured poor at counting/comparing numbers and free policy choices (design §2.7 'Not asked anywhere'; verify/progress.ts header) — so an LLM+Jev variant should have the LLM generate candidates and Jev rank/arbitrate them, with tests as oracle.

Tests as the oracle at every layer means an LLM candidate is treated identically once it is a Candidate: no code path trusts `source`; only display strings (`${c.source}/${c.op}` in proposal.ts:180-187, guard notes) and the source-name lists above read it.

An LLM source needs a new EngineMode (core/types.ts:371) or a metered `generate` on the context; passing a Provider into createSubGoalDeps (src/synth/index.ts:217) would bypass spend metering and the assertion.

StepBudget has no LLM counter (src/synth/search/types.ts:75-82; budget.ts:750-764); subgoal.ts:443 spend() decrements jevRequestsLeft, so LLM requests are either uncounted or charged against the 30/60 Jev caps; `exhausted()` at budget.ts:761 would then end steps early or never.

The inner loop is sequential (subgoal.ts:783 await rank, :796 await runBatch): a multi-second LLM call stalls the lanes; design §4.2's 'requests issued while the batch runs' is not implemented. checkAborted runs only at visitSource start (:747); an LLM call must honour ctx.signal itself (see rank/index.ts:200-217 askAbortable for the pattern).

Candidate identity assumes a localised Site: applyCandidate throws when the site line (or span tokens) no longer equals currentLine (verify/apply.ts:113-129); an LLM candidate must be anchored to an existing Site (or one constructed from file.mod.lines with exact currentLine/indent/block/scope) and express other hunks as extraEdits in before-edit numbering; > 2 files is refused only at proposePatch (proposal.ts:649) after the ledger recorded the commit unless filtered earlier (commitProgress :672-677 does, the main commit path does not).

rank/index.ts:307 throws RangeError when any candidate is not at the ranked site: an LLM source that returns candidates at several sites in one JevEnumeration crashes RANK mode; split per site or route to SIEVE.

Vocabulary pre-check (sieve/queue.ts:461) drops any candidate whose NAME tokens are outside file ∪ tests ∪ task ∪ builtins ('vocab' drop counted, not surfaced); LLM fixes that introduce a new helper name are unreachable unless EnumerateOptions.extraNames feeds createQueue (src/synth/index.ts:99-109) or the check is bypassed per source.

Source-name lists are hard-coded: SEED_SOURCES (subgoal.ts:156) drives seedsExhaustedAt (:306-309) which gates SKETCH/BEAM/WIDENED (:996, :1002, :1008) and the §5.3 stagnation rule (:429-431); SITE_BATCH_SOURCES (guard.ts:125) drives hold rule (a). A new source is invisible to both unless added; exhaustedKey collision: SKETCH and BEAM both key 'token_beam' and rely on the '#SKETCH' suffix (subgoal.ts:292-294).

Four exhaustive records must grow with the union or TypeScript fails / runtime drops data: emptyBySource (subgoal.ts:403), SOURCE_ORDER_PRIOR (queue.ts:58), SOURCE_NAMES (bases.ts:621: persisted partials of an unknown source are silently skipped on resume), SearchTrace.bySource (types.ts:268); tests subgoal.test.ts:163,:200 enumerate names.

ProposalEvidence.selection is 'sieve'|'rank' only (core/types.ts:63; proposal.ts:215 selectionOf maps runMode): an LLM-generated winner would be labelled by the run mode, misleading the risk/judge stages that read evidence.

Determinism assumptions: CandidateSource.enumerate is documented pure/deterministic (types.ts:122); `tried` (sha12 of diff, memory.ts:234-247) and the queue's id/text dedupe (queue.ts:458-459) assume re-enumeration reproduces candidates across steps and --resume (design §2.1 'lost candidates are re-run at most'). A non-deterministic LLM source re-spends tokens on every step unless its outputs are cached in memory/synthState (synthState ≤ 64 KB, core/types.ts:1063; tried alone may take 45 KB, bases.ts:60-61).

Guard bias toward small edits: editCost token-Levenshtein (guard.ts:167-172) chooses cluster representatives and the all-overfit suspect (minEdit :179-184) and breaks Choice ties (:527); an LLM's larger but correct refactor loses ties and, if alone, trips duplicates_block/deletes_statement signals (:327-349) → Q16 hold.
Q15/Q16 state compresses a candidate to {line, replaces, with, also_edits} (guard.ts:452-458) and the program to ≤ 254 code lines; a multi-hunk LLM candidate is judged from that summary, not a diff.

Passer cap: runner stops dispatching at 5 passers per step (runner.ts:528) and defers the rest; an LLM source yielding many passers has most of them wait for the next call, and isPlausible requires the full run (guard.ts:609-611), so deferred passers are never committed this step.
Persisted partials drop edits > 400 chars or > 4 extraEdits (bases.ts:67-68, :603): large LLM partials do not survive --resume for pairing.

Single-line assumptions in identity/display (not in apply): siteKey file:line:kind (queue.ts:260, bases.ts:200) so two multi-line candidates at one line are 'alternatives' never a pair; isUnchanged compares only the site text tokens (queue.ts:265-269) and freshOf trims one line (subgoal.ts:727); candidateSignature/lineSignature and the 400-char clip in rank/questions.ts:207-233; patchGoalText/describeEdit name `${path}:${line}` (proposal.ts:148-188); editRecord clips text to PLAN_ITEM_MAX_CHARS (:457-468); composite excludes any text containing '\n' (composite.ts:250, :279); WIDENED enumerates per physical code line (subgoal.ts:1014); Q5/Q8 states are per-line Choices.
Improved-base remap: siteOnBase (subgoal.ts:371-383) returns null when a partial shifted the line, so LLM candidates anchored by line silently skip the improved base.

Lane pool rebuild: runner.ts:482-485 disposes and recreates lanes when oracle.lanes grows; worktree lanes replay dirty entries (≤ 200 untracked, lanes.ts:45) — an LLM source that writes scratch files into the workspace would be replayed into every lane.

Wall accounting: LedgerSieveSynthesizer.wallRemaining (search/index.ts:540-542) starts at the first call of this process; LLM latency inside synthesize() is charged to the step wall only through testWallLeftMs if the runner runs afterwards, not as its own budget.
